text:
nisha: SI update: during today's customer arch review the integrator hit a stall on Private deployment DNS+egress for the runtime. Asking for quick design check and escalation path.
liam: Can you summarise symptoms? DNS failures or connections timeout? :mag:
nisha: DNS resolves, but runtime outbound calls to control plane time out intermittently. Customer uses TGW with route propagation disabled and strict egress inspection.
rex: Sounds like SNAT/egress issue. If the worker IPs aren't in the TGW route table, reply traffic could be blackholed. Did the SI add propagated routes for the 10.60.0.0/20 subnet?
nisha: They added static routes for subnets but the ops team rejected propagation across accounts. Customer security wants explicit approval for any propagated prefixes.
liam: Two options: A) Ask customer to add explicit TGW route entries for our worker CIDRs B) Configure runtime to use a fixed egress IP/NAT gateway in the customer's control plane. Which is easier for them?
rex: Option B respects their security posture (single audited NAT IP). We'll need them to open outbound to redwood-control.internal on 443 from that NAT IP. Minimal route table changes.
isha: They prefer minimal infra changes. ACTION: @kevin (SI lead) collect NAT gateway IP and security contact; @liam draft the minimal ACL doc for customer's firewall team.
isha: Also during the arch call they asked about our recommended HA pattern for Private when TGW is in play. I suggested AZ-local NLB + cross-AZ fallback. They want a short diagram and one-pager.
isha: Rex, can you sketch the pattern quickly?
rex: Sketch inlined:
```
customer VPCs -- TGW -- Redwood private VPC (AZ a/b)
- Workers in AZ-local subnets
- NLB per AZ with health checks
- NAT GW for control egress
- TGW routes: explicit worker CIDR -> attachment
```
liam: Perfect. I'll convert to one-pager and include SOW note for migration assistance if they want us to provision NAT.
kevin: SI update: we can request temporary cross-account read to TGW route table (customer approved) so we can validate routes. Requesting now.
deploy-bot: Incident ticket created: PVT-9122 "SI: Private egress failures during integration". Assigned to partnerships/si and infra-networking.
rex: Quick troubleshooting checklist for SI engineers I posted to confluence: 1) confirm TGW attachment propagation 2) verify route for worker CIDR 3) validate NAT egress IP 4) check security inspector logs for dropped conn 5) scale down connection tracking and retry.
liam: One more ask from customer: they'd like to see our marketplace/hardware partner checklist to confirm compatibility with their firewall appliance. We have a short compatibility matrix, I'll attach in the one-pager.
kevin: Noted. If we need to escalate for on-site networking help, flag partner-eng early. Pricing for onsite will need quick approval.
isha: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread as the canonical escalation record. If TGW read confirms missing routes, we'll try NAT approach first and only request route edits if customer wants it. :white_check_mark:
